fragments.text: Hello, Flanders conference hotel. Angela speaking. I'm the

fragments.text: Oh, hi. I wanted to ask about

sentences.translation: 哦，你好。我想咨询一下酒店的会议设施。我问对人了吗？

fragments.text: You have. I'm the customer services

fragments.text: Well, I'm calling from Barrett and Stansons, we're a medical company based in Perth.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 嗯，我来自巴雷特和斯坦森公司，我们是一家位于珀斯的医疗公司。

fragments.text: Oh yes.

sentences.speaker: Angela
sentences.translation: 嗯，好的。

fragments.text: And we're organising a conference for our
to be held in Sydney. It'll be held over
and we're expecting about
people.

sentences.translation: 我们想要在悉尼举行一场客户会议。会议将持续两天，我们大约有五六十人参会。

fragments.text: When were you thinking of having it?

sentences.speaker: Angela
sentences.translation: 你们想什么时候举行这场会议？

fragments.text: Some time early next year, like the end of January? It'd have to be a weekend.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 明年初的某个时候，比如一月底？会议得在周末举行。

fragments.text: Let me see... our conference facilities are already booked for the weekend beginning
. We could do the first weekend in February?

sentences.speaker: Angela
sentences.translation: 让我看看...1月28日开始的那个周末我们的会议设施已经被预订了。可以给您预定二月份的第一个周末吗？

fragments.text: How about

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 1月21日怎么样？

fragments.text: I'm afraid that's booked too.

sentences.speaker: Angela
sentences.translation: 抱歉，恐怕那时候也被预定了。

fragments.text: Well, let's go for the February date then.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 好吧，那我们再看看二月的日期。

fragments.text: So that's the weekend beginning the 4th.

sentences.speaker: Angela
sentences.translation: 所以那是2月4日开始的周末了。

fragments.text: OK. Now can you tell me a bit about what conference facilities you have?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 好的。现在，您能说说你们有什么会议设施吗？

fragments.text: Sure. So for talks and presentations we have the Tesla room.

sentences.speaker: Angela
sentences.translation: 好的。我们有特斯拉的房间用于演讲和演示。

fragments.text: Sorry?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 抱歉？

fragments.text: Tesla - that's spelled T-E-S-L-A. It holds up to a hundred people, and it's fully equipped with a
and so on.

sentences.speaker: Angela
sentences.translation: 特斯拉，拼写为T-E-S-L-A。它可容纳一百人，并配备了投影仪等。

fragments.text: How about a

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 麦克风呢？

members of the
can use too, for questions, if necessary.

sentences.translation: 有的，这些都将为你们准备好，而且如有必要，观众也可以使用麦克风来提问。

fragments.text: Fine. And we'll also need some sort of open area where people can sit and have a cup of coffee, and we'd like to have an exhibition of our
there as well, so that'll need to be quite a big space.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 好的。而且我们还需要某种开放区域，人们可以坐下来喝杯咖啡，我们也希望在那里展示我们的产品和服务，所以这需要相当大的空间。

fragments.text: That's fine, there's a central atrium with all those facilities, and you can come before the conference starts if you want to set everything up.

sentences.speaker: Angela
sentences.translation: 没关系，我们有一个中庭设有所有这些设施，如果你们想要把这些都布置好，可以在会议开始前就过来。

fragments.text: Great. And I presume there's wifi?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 很好。那里应该有WiFi吧？

fragments.text: Oh, yes, that's
and available throughout the hotel.

sentences.speaker: Angela
sentences.translation: 哦，有的，在整个酒店都可以免费使用。

fragments.text: OK.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 好的。

fragments.text: Would you also like us to
a buffet
? We can do a two-
with a number of different options.

sentences.speaker: Angela
sentences.translation: 您还希望我们提供自助午餐吗？我们可以提供有两道菜的正餐，还有很多不同的选择。

fragments.text: What sort of price are we looking at for that?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 那样的话价格是怎样呢？

fragments.text: Well, I can send you a copy of the standard menu. That's
per person. Or you can have the special for
more.

sentences.speaker: Angela
sentences.translation: 嗯，我可以寄给你一份标准菜单。那是每人45美元。或者您还可以选择特别菜单，每人多加25美元。

fragments.text: I think the standard should be ok, but yes, send me the menu.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 我认为标准菜单应该就可以了，但还是给我发一份菜单吧。

fragments.text: Now we're also going to need
on the Saturday night for some of the participants... I'm not sure how many, but probably about 25. So what do you charge for a room?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 现在我们也需要在星期六晚上为一些参与者提供住宿……我不知道有多少，但可能大约25人。你们一个房间收费多少？

, so we can offer you rooms at
. Normally a standard room's

sentences.translation: 嗯，对于与会者我们有25％的优惠，所以我们可以为您提供收费135美元的房间。通常一个标间为180美元。

fragments.text: And does that include breakfast?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 包含早餐吗？

fragments.text: Sure. And of course, guests can also make use of all the other facilities at the hotel. So we've got a spa where you can get
and facials and so on, and there's a pool up on the roof for the use of guests.

sentences.speaker: Angela
sentences.translation: 当然包含。此外，客人还可以使用酒店的所有其他设施。我们有一个水疗中心，你可以享受按摩和面部护理等等。屋顶上有一个游泳池供客人使用。

fragments.text: Great. Now what about transport links? The hotel's downtown, isn't it?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 太好了。现在来说说交通方面。酒店在市中心对吧？

fragments.text: Yes, it's about
from the airport, but there's a
shuttle bus for guests. And it's only about ten minutes' walk from the central railway station.

sentences.speaker: Angela
sentences.translation: 是的，酒店离机场大约12公里。但是有为客人提供的免费的往返巴士。从酒店步行到中央火车站仅约10分钟。

fragments.text: OK. Now, I don't know Sydney very well, can you just give me an idea of the location of the hotel?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 好的。我对悉尼不太熟，你现在能告诉我一下酒店的位置吗？

fragments.text: Well, it's on Wilby Street, that's quite a small street, and it's not very far from the sea. And of course if the conference

of places to eat. Then if they want to make a night of it, they can go on to one of the
in the area - there are a great many to choose from.

sentences.speaker: Angela
sentences.translation: 嗯。酒店位于威尔比街的市中心，这是一条很小的街道，距离大海不远。当然，如果与会者想要在周六晚上出去，也有很多吃饭的地方可供选择。然后，如果他们想要在外面呆一晚上，他们可以去俱乐部，这儿有很多俱乐部可供选择。

with this, can you give me some information about how much...
